main.description: A host/AppView countersignature on an RSVP — the SEAT, as distinct from the RSVP's INTENT. An RSVP (community.lexicon.calendar.rsvp) lives on the attendee's PDS and says 'I want in'; the acceptance says 'you're confirmed/waitlisted/requested', decided by capacity arbitration. The ticket is the countersignature, not the claim. Modeled on Smoke Signal's events.smokesignal.calendar.acceptance. NOTE: in v0 the seat decision is authoritative in the AppView's Postgres ledger and this record is not yet minted to a PDS — minting awaits host-delegated signing. The shape is reserved here.

position.description: Waitlist position (monotonic, arrival order) when state = waitlisted.
